rationale: Phase B3f (portfolio_positioning fleet buildout, the last Phase B config step before the Phase C pilot): enable eleven discovery checks on completeness-discovery-agent - the three finance directory pairs (missing_mortgage_lender_directory_section/_page, missing_savings_provider_directory_section/_page, missing_health_insurer_directory_section/_page; registered in check_directory.go since the B1/B2 commit) and the five Phase-A structural-validity checks (dead_internal_link_live, canonical_mismatch, structured_data_invalid, head_essentials_missing, sitemap_entry_dead_live; check_site_structural_validity.go, council-reviewed as A1). Enabling now is deliberately BEFORE the Phase C pilot builds: the directory checks self-gate twice (per-site opt-in flag content_features.<spec_key>, which zero sites carry today, AND current found claims of that kind in the register, which B4 populated for all three finance kinds on 2026-08-15), so they produce zero work items until the pilot opts in - at which point they are the machinery that would catch a pilot build missing its directory page. The structural checks are flag-only routing per A1's council round and run only when a completeness sweep is dispatched at a site (per-site on demand, owner ruling 2026-07-24). An unregistered check name would be silently skipped, not an error, so the binary precondition was proven at the artefact: the running chassis binary was probed for both new-name literals with a positive AND negative control in the same breath.

plan.summary: Migration 434 (applied 2026-08-15): append eleven check names (three finance directory pairs + five Phase-A structural checks) to completeness-discovery-agent's run_checks array via the 194/215 jsonb_set pattern, hardened with exactly-one-active-row, none-already-enabled and count-verify DO/RAISE guards; surgical-inverse ROLLBACK that rebuilds the array without the eleven and refuses on partial state.
plan.risks: (1) The five structural checks will fire on every future completeness sweep fleet-wide; their finding volume on real sites is UNMEASURED (A1 shipped them flag-only for exactly this reason) - the first post-434 sweeps should be watched and this is stated in the lane handoff rather than assumed benign. (2) The six directory checks are inert until a site opts in; the Phase C pilot is the intended first consumer - absence of directory work items before then is NOT a failure. (3) The verify block pins jsonb_array_length = 43, so a concurrent checks-array edit by another lane between measurement and apply aborts the transaction (safe failure, re-measure and re-run). (4) The ROLLBACK's length-32 expectation goes stale if another lane appends checks after 434 - its refusal message says exactly that and what to do, rather than silently proceeding. (5) Config-only, live immediately; no image roll needed - the binary already registers all eleven names (probed with controls).
